name: podcast-summary
description: A podcast or interview link → an animated 2-6 min summary (and/or a 60 s Short) in the speakers' real voices: whole-sentence clips cut from the episode, each speaker's real photo animated into a talking face from their own voice (or a code-drawn mascot), word-synced captions, topic titles, stat cards, a -14 LUFS master, a thumbnail and posting copy. Free and local. Add-on to make-video and snipshorts.
